item.title: Ask HN: What part of modern Git hosting system is the most crucial one for you
item.summary: Hey, I am writing gitlab/gitea alternative , what part of modern git hosting system is the most crucial one for you ? I use #dsci #rakulang #golang #bulma 1) CICD 2) Merge requests 3) Collaboration ( tickets, discussions ) 4) Code highlighting 5) Something else Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49229980 Points: 1 # Comments: 1
